title: MediaInfo — unified media facts model (single source of truth)
description: Canonical media facts produced by the Blender-native inspect_media operation. Values are not re-derived with ffprobe; fps follows Blender's native decode result (for example, a 29.97 source may report 30.0).

path.description: Absolute path of the inspected media file.

fps.description: Source fps (video only; null for audio). Blender-native whole-number value.

video_codec.description: Always null — Blender's native API does not expose codec strings.

audio_codec.description: Always null — not exposed by the native API.

audio_channels.description: MONO=1 / STEREO=2, decoded from the sound datablock.

sample_rate.description: Always null — not exposed by the native API.

native.description: Provenance + raw native fields so consumers can audit where facts came from.
